text:
maria (PM): Quick sync: we need a compact playbook for pinning, deprecation windows, and customer migration comms before we open the beta.
aj (eng): +1. Customers keep surprised when a minor bump changes output. Need SDK support first.
sasha (ML): Proposal for semver-like tags for models:
- MAJOR: architecture/weight format changes (breaking)
- MINOR: training/data/tokenizer changes (semantics may shift)
- PATCH: performance/tuning fixes (non-breaking)
Minor updates should be opt-in for pinned routes.
devrel (solutions): Customers want short compatibility blurbs per model. One-liners like: "Expected delta: -2% ROUGE on summarization; note: longer contexts >8k may regress". Also need snippet examples to migrate.
tina (CS): Enterprise asks: 90 days minimum deprecation window for pinned versions. Can we make hosted default 30d and enterprise 90d?
aj (eng): That split works. Hosted default 30d, Dedicated/Private SLA => 90d. We'll also support an explicit "retain_until" flag for customers on Dedicated.
sasha (ML): Add automated eval matrices: for each candidate release run regression suite vs pinned suite; surface three numbers: mean delta, top-3 regressions, hallucination rate delta.
maria (PM): Launch criteria checklist idea:
- SDK: model_version query param and SDK flag
- Console catalog: compatibility blurb + benchmark links
- Docs: migration guide + email templates
- Infra: deprecation calendar entry and fallback routing tested
- Evals: baseline + candidate reports attached
aj (eng): SDK plan: add ?model_version=2025-11-01 and keep default as "latest-minor". Backwards compatibility: if param absent, behavior unchanged. I'll add unit + integration tests.
devrel (solutions): I'll draft the migration email + console banner copy. Example banner: "Model X moved to v2.4 on 2025-11-01. Pin to v2.3 for identical outputs." Include code snippet:
```
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-2', model_version: 'v2.3' });
```
ops-bot: Notice: add any approved retirement to calendar://model-deprecations and tag #incidents if rollout is >5% error spike.
tina (CS): Also require a customer communication playbook: email cadence (day 0, 30, 7 days before), console banner, changelog entry, and handoff doc for CSMs.
maria (PM): Scope decision: do we auto-map to quantized artifacts (v2.x -> v2.x-q4) in this phase?
aj (eng): Defer auto-mapping to Optimize team H2. For now include recommended quantized artifacts in catalog but do not auto-route.
sasha (ML): We'll publish recommended quantized variant and quality notes. No auto-routing until we have regression signals on quantized variants.
maria (PM): Action items:
- aj (eng): RFC + SDK PR for model_version param, add tests
- sasha (ML): compatibility template + eval checklist + automation to publish the report
- devrel: migration docs, email + banner copy, sample code
- tina (CS): compile enterprise pinning requirements, own the 90-day confirmation
- ops-bot / infra: deprecation calendar hookup + fallback routing test harness
aj (eng): I'll open RFC and include perf-cost matrix for minor vs patch changes.
devrel (solutions): I'll prepare one-pager and two short migration examples for the docs site.
tina (CS): I'll run a quick poll with top 5 enterprise customers about 90d and report by EOW.
maria (PM): Aim for a small pilot next sprint (3 customers). Beta checklist must be green before broader rollout. Ping here when PRs are up :thumbsup:
aj (eng): On it. Thanks everyone.
